summary: Thursday's close reflected a stronger dollar and firmer real yields squeezing gold and long duration, with DXY up over the past two weeks and 10-year TIPS yields running well above their recent average. Capital rotated instead into mega-cap tech and crypto, while small caps, staples, and long bonds lagged behind the broader market.
tweet: A firmer dollar and higher real yields pressured gold and bonds Thursday, while tech and crypto kept climbing and breadth stayed thin.
